items.title: 初次见面
items.text: 无须行礼，此身虽然尊贵殊胜，不过此般前来，是想要做些微服游历民间的事。我看上了你的身手，现在你就是我的御侧保镖了。不用担心，遇到危险，我会出手的。
items.text_en: No salutations needed. My exalted status shall not be disclosed as we travel among the common folk. I acknowledge that you are a person of superior ability. Henceforth, you will be my guard. Worry not. Should any danger arise, I shall dispose of it.

items.title: 闲聊·徒然
items.text: 徒然无事，对砚枯坐。哼。
items.text_en: Inactivity serves no purpose whatsoever. Hmph.

items.title: 闲聊·浮世
items.text: 浮世景色百千年依旧，人之在世却如白露与泡影。虚无。
items.text_en: The world remains constant over the centuries. But human life is like the dew at dawn or a bubble rising through water. Transitory.

items.title: 闲聊·花鸟余情
items.text: 无人相陪，此般花鸟余情，也不过衬托我身不移不变的背景罢了。
items.text_en: All the world holds dear is but a backdrop of constant motion. I stand before it alone and unchanging.

items.title: 下雨的时候
items.text: 只是雨滴有什么麻烦的。这还没有打雷呢。
items.text_en: Rainfall alone does not constitute a storm. Thunder is required.

items.title: 打雷的时候
items.text: 哎呀，你不会怕了吧。明明此世最为殊胜最为恐怖的雷霆化身就站在你身边。
items.text_en: Complete "Omnipresence Over Mortals"Dear me, that didn't frighten you, did it? After all, you are in the presence of the most supreme and terrifying incarnation of lightning in the whole of Teyvat.

items.title: 下雪的时候
items.text: 冬将军也来了。
items.text_en: The Winter Shogun approaches.

items.title: 晴天的时候
items.text: 天晴也并不能掩盖雷霆的威光。不下雨也可以降下神雷，看到那棵树了吗？你说你懂了，叫我停手。好吧。
items.text_en: Clear skies can do nothing to hide the brilliance of lightning. Divine bolts can strike even in the absence of rain. Do you see that tree? Wait... you understand? So... demonstration is not required? Good.

items.title: 早上好
items.text: 道完早安就打呵欠，太懈怠了。我这次就赦免你的无礼了。早安。
items.text_en: Yawning without covering your mouth? Uncouth. I will pardon your rudeness this time. Good morning to you, too.

items.title: 中午好
items.text: 啊，想吃甜点心。嗯，为什么不行？什么叫「哪有这个时间吃甜品的」。之前是因为他们看我是将军所以惯着我的？这样啊。
items.text_en: Complete "Omnipresence Over Mortals"Time for dessert. What? Why not? What do you mean, "Entrées come first"? ...They were only indulging me because I am the Shogun? Huh, interesting.

items.title: 晚上好
items.text: 你想知道夜晚流星的真相吗？哈哈，真相就是缥缈须臾的一瞬天光罢了。嗯，你说其实是你？你也是天狗吗？
items.text_en: Complete "Omnipresence Over Mortals"Do you wish to know the truth about the shooting stars at night? Haha, they are but fleeting moments of luminosity. Uh, you used to be one of them? Are you a tengu warrior?

items.title: 晚安
items.text: 我命十方世界雷鸣平息，愿你今晚得享安睡。
items.text_en: I command the thunder in all corners of the world to cease. Rest well tonight.

items.title: 关于雷电将军自己·须臾
items.text: 雷鸣闪电，一瞬即逝。正因如此，才会想要撷取「永恒」。不，才必须掌握「永恒」。
items.text_en: Thunder's roar and lightning's flash. So ephemeral. This is why reaching Eternity is desirable. ...Actually, no — this is why reaching Eternity is necessary.

items.title: 关于雷电将军自己·永恒
items.text: 「磨损」是一件很可怕的事情。此身诞生的意义，就是承受磨损。这样，或许「内在」就可以触及永恒了吧。
items.text_en: Erosion is a terrible thing. This body's purpose is to withstand wear and tear, that the one within might achieve Eternity.

items.title: 关于我们·奥诘众
items.text: 现在你是我的侧用人，换言之，依我判断，你是对幕府有用，对我忠诚的人。
items.text_en: I declare you my chamberlain. In other words, according to my judgment, you are useful to the Shogunate and loyal to me.

items.title: 关于我们·用心棒
items.text: 虽然是微服出访的保镖，但是我遇到危险不用替我挡刀了。将军她构造还挺结实的，坏了还能替换呢。所以遇到危险把将军她推到前面就好了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Complete "Omnipresence Over Mortals"Despite serving as my guard during this journey, you need not shield me from danger. The Shogun's constitution is rather robust, and in the event she does break down, we can simply get a replacement. In an emergency, just send her into the fray.

items.title: 关于我们·直传
items.text: 稻妻的薙刀术和剑术以及锻刀技法，基本都是由我直接传下的，随后因人资质不同而分枝开花、各自结果。如何，再接我一刀？还能无事的话，许可你在稻妻开宗立派哦。啊，武艺的精进真是叫人欲罢不能。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Complete "Omnipresence Over Morals"The Inazuman arts of polearm and sword combat, as well as the blade-forging process itself, primarily originated with me. Since then, they have branched out and blossomed into a variety of techniques according to each master's individual aptitude. What would you say to another sparring session? If you emerge unscathed again, I'll let you found your own martial arts tradition in Inazuma. Ah, the drive to advance and evolve in the martial arts is truly unstoppable.

items.title: 关于「神之眼」
items.text: 外面的世界居然已经这么久没有出现过雷元素的神之眼了吗？虽然我因为一些制约无法说明…赐予神之眼这件事，和我的意志无关。重要的，还是人的「渴望」，以及…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "Omnipresence Over Mortals"Really? So in all this time, no new Electro Visions have appeared in the outside world? Well, what I can say on this topic is subject to certain constraints, but... it is not by my will that Visions are granted or denied. The key is people's desire, and... well, there's another side to it too.

items.title: 有什么想要分享
items.text: 有什么想要分享的？没有。倒是你，为什么没有神之眼却能使用元素之力。和我说说。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4No, I have nothing to share with you at this time. But you... You use elemental energy without the aid of a Vision. How is this possible? Please enlighten me.

items.title: 感兴趣的见闻
items.text: 虽然身消梦陨，但是她化作了神樱。这，也是「永恒」。
items.text_en: Her body may have perished, but she became the Sacred Sakura. This, too, is a form of Eternity.

items.title: 关于八重神子
items.text: 那家伙啊，最初她就是个会被油豆腐引诱的家伙。现在居然这么工于谋略了，让人欣慰。不过被她算计了，还是有些不愉快。虽说是为了我好，下次见到她恐怕会被她嘲笑的…那就先发制人，斩她一刀好了。反正她也能躲掉。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "Omnipresence Over Mortals"Ah, that girl... She used to be the kind of person who could easily be swayed with some Fried Tofu. It's a relief to see how shrewd and resourceful she's now become. Still, I have to admit that I was a little upset to become the target of her scheming myself. I know it was for my own good, but I'm afraid she will mock me next time we meet... Perhaps I should take the initiative and strike her first? Hmm, she'll dodge it anyway.

items.title: 关于神里绫人
items.text: 神里一门，无愧于稻妻名门笔头之格。绫人虽然此前在三奉行事务中，耍了不少手段，但是本身忠心可鉴。既往不咎了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Kamisato... One of the most distinguished clans in all of Inazuma. Despite Ayato's trickery in regard to the Tri-Commission's affairs, he is nevertheless a loyal subject. His past misdeeds shall be excused.

items.title: 关于神里绫华
items.text: 神里一门，无愧于稻妻名门笔头之格。欸，你说我和将军的评价一模一样。那，绫华她，她剑术也很好。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "Omnipresence Over Mortals"Kamisato... One of the most distinguished clans in all of Inazuma. Eh? That's exactly what the Shogun said? Well, A—Ayaka's also well-versed in the art of the sword.

items.title: 关于九条裟罗
items.text: 忠义之士，武艺精湛，可担「豪杰」二字。有此麟儿，九条家应该还能兴盛下去吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4A loyal and righteous subject, and an accomplished warrior. She is worthy to be called a hero. With an heir of such great promise, the future prosperity of the Kujou Clan is assured.

items.title: 关于宵宫
items.text: 是谁来着？啊，做烟火的。制造须臾幻象的人，沉醉于夏日幻觉的人，虽说如此，亦为我之臣民。嗯，在天领奉行属地里炸烟花？谁啊，她吗？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "Omnipresence Over Mortals"Who? Ah, the firework maker. A manufacturer of fleeting illusions, enamored with the realm of fantasy and imagination, but a subject of mine nonetheless. Hmm? Fireworks were released on Tenryou Commission property? By whom... her?

items.title: 关于托马
items.text: 虽然差点夺走他神之眼这件事，我也不能说是完全没有责任。但要说道歉的话，还是应该让将军她去比较好吧…好吧，我也会好好反省的。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "Omnipresence Over Mortals"I can't deny that I am somewhat culpable in the events that led to him being almost stripped of his Vision, but I rather think the Shogun should be the one to extend a formal apology to him... Okay, fine. I'll give it some more thought.

items.title: 关于珊瑚宫心海
items.text: 奥罗巴斯确为此身所斩。但是我也许可了珊瑚宫之民，以海祇大御神之名继续祭祀，让它得享牲醴。现在珊瑚宫捣毁鸣神分社，反叛幕府。她作为海祇大御神的现人神巫女，必须要承担责任。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Indeed. It was I who slew Orobaxi. But I also allowed the people of Sangonomiya to continue worshiping it as the Watatsumi Omikami, so that it might enjoy their offerings. Now, Sangonomiya has destroyed the local Narukami Shrine and rebels against the Shogunate. As the Divine Priestess representing the Watatsumi Omikami, she must be held accountable.

items.title: 关于国崩
items.text: 那小子是制造将军的副产物。对他不加以管束，应该是因为我内心还是觉得对他有所亏欠吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "Omnipresence Over Mortals"He came about as a byproduct of creating the Shogun. Perhaps it's because I feel like I owe him something, but I do not wish to assert control over him.

items.title: 关于荒泷一斗
items.text: 谁？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Who?

items.title: 关于摩拉克斯
items.text: 曾经与他共饮之时，我还只是一介影武者，敬陪众神末席。他做出了这样的选择是吗？不过，我想他在下一个时代，仍然会继续和更多的人相遇吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "Omnipresence Over Mortals"I had an opportunity to feast with him once, back when I was just a kagemusha attending a gathering of the gods. So he's made his choice. Be that as it may, I don't believe his story is anywhere near finished yet.

items.title: 关于温迪
items.text: 风神的化身现在还叫这个名字吗？说实话，第一次见他就感觉他浑身透着和我一定相处不来的气质。然后就是，他的确很能喝酒。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "Omnipresence Over Mortals"Hmm. So, the Anemo Archon still goes by that name among mortals these days? Truth be told, from the very first moment I met him, I could somehow sense that we were not going to get along. Also, he sure can drink a lot.

items.title: 想要了解雷电将军·其一
items.title_en: More About the Raiden Shogun: I
items.text: 有什么事情，说来便是。
items.text_en: State your query. To the point.

items.title: 想要了解雷电将军·其二
items.title_en: More About the Raiden Shogun: II
items.text: 民间都相信，雷雨天口念「桑原桑原」，便可以无恙。如是因我一念而起的雷暴，必不会加害于你。但是自然天气形成的雷雨就难说了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 3On stormy days, the people of Inazuma chant "kuwabara, kuwabara," believing that this will protect themselves from being struck by lightning. You need not worry about any storm summoned by my own hand — they will bring you no harm. Lightning storms that occur naturally, however, can be more unpredictable.

items.title: 想要了解影·其三
items.text: 《珍说》一书所言大致都是真的。那时她正忙于周旋岛内之事，于是我作为影武者，假托她名出现在了平定海祇的军阵中。但是后面的剧情，就只是人们的一厢情愿罢了。我原本只是醉心剑技的武人，没有那种感化万民的德行。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "Omnipresence Over Mortals"The account given in the book "Treasured Tales" is largely an accurate one. At that time, she was preoccupied with various domestic matters within the island, so as her kagemusha, I assumed her identity and joined the troops dispatched to pacify Watatsumi. After this point, however, the story turns into mere wishful thinking. Back then, I was just a martial artist wrapped up in all the fighting, not a social reformer or a moral leader.

items.title: 想要了解影·其四
items.text: 追求「永恒」可能也只是一种逃避罢了。最后我采取的方法也和缩壳乌龟一样。不过乌龟本来就是长寿的象征，说不定追求永恒就是会变成这样的形态。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 5Complete "Omnipresence Over Mortals"Perhaps my pursuit of Eternity is nothing more than a form of escapism. In the end, the path I took was like that of a turtle who hides in its shell. Still, turtles have always been a symbol of longevity. Perhaps in order to reach Eternity, one has to follow their example.

items.title: 想要了解影·其五
items.text: 恐惧是因为我在五百年前目睹了她的消亡和「那个事物」。但，如果…如果是你的话，一定可以拯救所有人的。如果是你的话，一定会拯救世界的。就像是我记得稻妻的一切一样，只要你记得我，我就能永远地活着。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Complete "Omnipresence Over Mortals"I'm fearful because of what I witnessed five hundred years ago — her demise and... that thing. But, if... If it were you, everyone would be safe. You would've saved the world. Just like I cherish the memories of everything in Inazuma, if you remember me, I'll live forever.

items.title: 雷电将军的爱好
items.text: 愚问。只有必须要做的事情，和一定不能做的事情。
items.text_en: Foolish question. There are only two kinds of things — those that must be done and those that must not.

items.title: 影的烦恼
items.text: 你不要让我做饭啦。我什么都能办到，但是真的不会做饭。
items.text_en: Complete "Omnipresence Over Mortals"Don't try and get me to cook. I can take care of anything else, but not that.

items.title: 喜欢的食物
items.text: 你别听将军她的。甜点心！蛀牙什么的，换一套就好了。这怎么会影响对永恒的追求呢。
items.text_en: Complete "Omnipresence Over Mortals"Oh, don't listen to the Shogun. Desserts! Cavities are no big deal — you can just replace your teeth. Anyway, I just don't see how desserts can pose a serious obstacle to my pursuit of Eternity.

items.title: 讨厌的食物
items.text: 愚问。只有维持身体营养必须吃的，和会损害身体的。
items.text_en: Foolish question. There are only two kinds of foods — those that must be consumed to nourish the body and those that harm it.

items.title: 生辰
items.text: 今日是你的生辰之日吗？随我回城，我来对全体旗本众宣读祝词吧。嗯？「太丢人别这样。」…好吧。
items.text_en: Is today the day of your creation? Return to the city with me. I will read out a speech for you in front of all my attendants. "Embarrassing"? ...Understood.

items.title: 生日
items.text: 生日快乐！那今日就一起庆祝吧，使之成为可以铭记一年的美好瞬间。然后等到来年今日，便继续庆祝。如是便可得「永恒」的快乐。
items.text_en: Happy birthday! Let's celebrate together and make it a moment to remember for the whole year until your next birthday celebration, and so on and so forth. Then, you shall have an eternity of happiness.

items.title: 突破的感受·起
items.text: 我之流派里，「初传」之位，可以学习太刀的九向剑路之势，以及薙刀术的基本。与其他流派并无大差异。应该说，其他流派与我之流派并无差异。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 1The initial stage of my journey, or Shoden, involves learning the nine-way sword slash and the foundations of the art of the polearm. There is no great variation from other traditions at this point. Or rather, it is the other traditions that do not differ from mine.

items.title: 突破的感受·承
items.text: 我之流派里，「中传」之位，太刀术需要研习各种「构」位与变化，薙刀术则需熟练诸「切」与「返」之理。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 2At the intermediate stage of my journey, or Chuuden, the art of the sword focuses on the study of various stances and transitions. The art of the polearm — slashes and backslashes.

items.title: 突破的感受·转
items.text: 我之流派里，「皆传」之位，需要研习诸般奥义。无奈大部分都需要配合元素之力，对凡人来说可能有些太难了。世间其余流派大多都无法触及此境。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 4The final stage of my journey, or Kaiden, is the study of the most profound techniques. Unavoidably, these draw heavily on elemental power, rendering them beyond the capabilities of most mortals. Most practitioners of other traditions are unable to ever reach this level.

items.title: 突破的感受·合
items.text: 奥义中的奥义，也就是「无想」又无双的一刀。有你作为陪练之宾，我好像能挥出更强更快的一剑。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 6The profoundest of the profound is the Musou no Hitotachi. A sword art without parallel in all the world. With you as my sparring partner, I can perfect that technique even further.

items.title: 元素战技·其一
items.text: 威光无赦！
items.text_en: Shine down!

items.title: 元素战技·其二
items.text: 无处遁逃！
items.text_en: There is no escape!

items.title: 元素战技·其三
items.text: 泡影看破！
items.text_en: Illusion shattered!

items.title: 元素爆发·其一
items.text: 无念，断绝！
items.text_en: Torn to oblivion!

items.title: 元素爆发·其二
items.text: 此刻，寂灭之时！
items.text_en: Now, you shall perish!

items.title: 元素爆发·其三
items.text: 稻光，亦是永恒！
items.text_en: Inazuma shines eternal!

items.title: 打开宝箱·其一
items.text: 收下吧，于我无用。
items.text_en: Take them. I have no need.

items.title: 打开宝箱·其二
items.text: …不过须臾之梦。
items.text_en: ...But a momentary distraction.

items.title: 打开宝箱·其三
items.text: 嗯？
items.text_en: Hmm?

items.title: 生命值低·其一
items.text: …枷锁当断。
items.text_en: ...Transcend all constraints.

items.title: 生命值低·其二
items.text: …诸恶当斩。
items.text_en: ...Erase all threats.

items.title: 生命值低·其三
items.text: …肃清阻碍。
items.text_en: ...Remove all obstacles.

items.title: 倒下·其一
items.text: 浮世一梦…
items.text_en: The mortal plane... A fleeting dream...

items.title: 倒下·其二
items.text: 无念，无执…
items.text_en: Detached from the world...

items.title: 倒下·其三
items.text: 雷鸣，将歇…
items.text_en: The thunder falls silent...

items.title: 重受击·其一
items.text: 无礼…
items.text_en: Insolent!

items.title: 重受击·其二
items.text: 荒谬…
items.text_en: Absurd!

items.title: 加入队伍·其一
items.text: 有什么事？
items.text_en: What is the situation?

items.title: 加入队伍·其二
items.text: 随我左右即可。
items.text_en: Stay close and you will live.

items.title: 加入队伍·其三
items.text: 出征之时已至。
items.text_en: The campaign begins.

items.title: 关于布耶尔
items.text: 我很欣赏她的谦逊，谦逊也的确是智者的美德。她的权能理应可以做到许多超乎想象的事，但布耶尔只是将它用在「纠正与守护」之上…真是个温柔的神明。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "Akasha Pulses, the Kalpa Flame Rises"I admire her humility: it is a sign of true wisdom. With the power she holds, Buer is capable of doing many things beyond our wildest imaginations... and yet, she uses her power only to right wrongs and to protect. She is a truly gentle god.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其一
items.text: 熟悉的味道。不坏。
items.text_en: A familiar flavor... Acceptable.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其二
items.text: 放在这里吧，我会尝的。
items.text_en: Leave it here, and I shall sample it.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其三
items.text: 会损害身体机能，拿走。
items.text_en: Consuming this would be physically detrimental. Remove it from my presence.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其四
items.text: 好吃。心情也放松了不少，谢谢你。
items.text_en: Complete "Omnipresence Over Mortals"Delicious. I feel much better after that. Thank you.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其五
items.text: 看起来不错，是怎么做出来的？
items.text_en: Complete "Omnipresence Over Mortals"Doesn't look too bad, how did you make it?

items.title: 收到赠礼·其六
items.text: 恕我谢绝。
items.text_en: Complete "Omnipresence Over Mortals"Allow me to decline.

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其一
items.text: 至我后方待命。
items.text_en: Fall back and await my orders.

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其二
items.text: 退下。
items.text_en: Step aside.
